meta.title: Psych Copilot — notes and reflection for therapists
meta.description: Drafts your session notes and offers gentle, supervisor-style reflection on your own practice. Built in Ireland. Audio deleted after transcription.

common.demoBanner: Demo mode: use role-play sessions only. Please don't record real clients yet.
common.somethingWrong: Something didn't work. Please try again in a moment.

landing.heroTitle: Be with your client. We'll take care of the rest.
landing.heroBody: Psych Copilot drafts your session notes and offers gentle, supervisor-style reflection on your own practice — so you can stay present in the room, and leave the paperwork lighter.
landing.howIntro: After the session, not during it. Nothing interrupts the work you do with your client.
landing.step1Body: Record an online call in your browser, a session in the room, upload audio — or simply type or dictate a short recap. Consent is recorded first, always.
landing.step2Body: A draft note in your format — SOAP, DAP, BIRP or free text — ready in a few minutes. Edit anything. Nothing is final until you approve it.
landing.step3Body: Three things you did well, two openings you might revisit, one idea to try next time — each linked to the exact moment in the session.
landing.reflectTitle: Feedback like a good supervisor would give
landing.reflectBody: Warm, specific and respectful. Grounded in the modality you practise — CBT, motivational interviewing, person-centred, solution-focused, DBT — and always pointing to what was actually said.
landing.sampleStrength: You reflected the client's ambivalence back without taking a side, which seemed to give them room to keep exploring.
landing.sampleOpening: When the client mentioned their sister, there may have been an opening to ask what that relationship means to them now.
landing.sampleTry: Next time, you might try a short summary before moving to homework, to check you've understood what matters most.
landing.supervisionBody: Each month, gather a summary of your client work, the moments you want to discuss, your own growth themes and an hours log in a format your supervisor will recognise. Bring it as a PDF.
landing.privacyIntro: Session content is some of the most sensitive information there is. Here's what we do with it, in plain words.
landing.promise1Body: By default, recordings are permanently deleted as soon as the transcript is ready. You can choose to keep them for 7 days instead.
landing.promise2Body: Our database, file storage, speech-to-text and AI processing all run in European data centres.
landing.promise3Body: Your sessions are never used to train our models or anyone else's.
landing.promise4Body: Clients are added by a code or initials. We don't ask for names, addresses or dates of birth.
landing.promise5Body: Recording can't start for a client until their consent is recorded — and withdrawing it stops recording straight away.
landing.promise6Body: Download everything, or delete a client or your whole account, at any time.
landing.notTitle: What Psych Copilot deliberately doesn't do
landing.not1: It doesn't advise you during a session.
landing.not3: It doesn't score or flag risk. Your notes record what was said, faithfully — the clinical judgement stays with you.
landing.pricingIntro: Free during the pilot. These are our planned prices afterwards.
landing.planFreeBody: 5 sessions a month. Notes and reflection.
landing.planSoloBody: Unlimited sessions, notes, reflection and client timelines.
landing.planGrowthBody: Everything in Solo, plus monthly supervision packs and an hours log.
landing.planCollegeBody: About €15 per student per month, for training courses.
landing.consentTemplateBody: A plain-language consent form for using a note-taking assistant in your practice. Use it with or without Psych Copilot.
landing.footerDisclaimer: Psych Copilot is a documentation and reflective-practice tool. It is not a medical device and does not give clinical advice.
landing.joinBody: Book a 20-minute demo with our team, or join the waiting list and we'll let you know when places open.
landing.joinPoint2: Built with a practising psychologist in Ireland
landing.joinPoint3: Role-play sessions first — real client sessions only after an independent privacy review

consent.title: Consent for {pseudonym}
consent.intro: Please read this with your client, or send it to them, before any recording.
consent.confirm: I confirm my client has given consent as described above
consent.withdrawBody: Recording for this client will stop straight away. Would you also like to delete the sessions recorded so far?
consent.required: Consent needs to be recorded before you can record a session with this client.
consent.textHeading: Using a note-taking assistant in our sessions
consent.textP1: I use a secure assistant called Psych Copilot to help me write my session notes and reflect on my own practice as a therapist.
consent.textP2: With your permission, our session is recorded. The recording is turned into a written transcript and then permanently deleted, usually within minutes.
consent.textP3: The transcript is used to draft my notes and to give me feedback on my own work. It is not used to diagnose you or to make decisions about you; I remain responsible for your care and for everything in my notes.
consent.textP4: Everything is stored securely in the European Union. You are identified only by a code, never by your name. Your information is never used to train AI systems.
consent.textP5: Saying no is completely fine and won't affect your therapy in any way. You can change your mind at any time, including during a session; I'll stop recording, and you can ask me to delete what has been recorded.
consent.textP6: You have the right to see the information I hold about you and to ask for it to be corrected or deleted.

session.modeTitle: How are you capturing this session?
session.mode_online_call_body: Zoom, Google Meet or Teams in this browser. You and your client are recorded as separate tracks.
session.mode_in_person_body: Place your phone or laptop between you. We'll tell your voices apart.
session.mode_upload_body: An audio file you've recorded yourself.
session.mode_recap_body: No recording at all. Ideal when you or your client prefer not to record.
session.browserCheckFail: Online-call recording needs Chrome or Edge on a computer. You can still record in the room, upload audio or write a recap.
session.onlineStep1: Open your Zoom, Meet or Teams call in another tab of this browser.
session.onlineStep2: Use headphones if you can, so your client's voice doesn't reach your microphone.
session.onlineStep3: When asked, choose the meeting tab and tick "Share tab audio".
session.macZoomHint: Using the Zoom desktop app on a Mac? Join the call from your browser instead, or record in the room.
session.tabNoAudio: We can't hear the meeting tab. Please share it again and tick "Share tab audio".
session.micDenied: We couldn't reach your microphone. Please allow microphone access for this site in your browser settings.
session.endConfirm: End the session and start preparing your note?
session.uploadBehind: Saving is a little behind — keep this tab open.
session.recoverBody: What was recorded so far is safe. You can continue recording or end the session now.
session.calibrateBody: Say a sentence or two so we can recognise your voice in this room.
session.uploadHint: MP3, M4A, WAV, WEBM or OGG, up to 300 MB. Only upload recordings made with your client's consent.
session.recapHint: Write or dictate what happened in the session, in your own words. Your note will be drafted from this. (Reflection on technique needs a recording, so it isn't offered for recaps.)
session.recapPlaceholder: What did you work on? What did your client bring? Anything agreed for next time?
session.dictationUnsupported: Dictation isn't available in this browser. You can type instead.

privacyPage.title: Privacy, in plain words
privacyPage.intro: Psych Copilot handles some of the most sensitive information there is. This page explains exactly what happens to it.
privacyPage.flow1: You record (or upload, or type a recap). Audio is uploaded in small pieces to storage in the EU.
privacyPage.flow2: Our speech-to-text runs on our own servers in the EU. The audio is then permanently deleted.
privacyPage.flow3: The transcript (text only, with a pseudonym, never a name) is sent to an AI model hosted in the EU to draft your note and reflection.
privacyPage.flow4: You review, edit and approve. You can export or delete everything at any time.
privacyPage.whoBody: Every company that touches your data is listed on our sub-processor page, with what they do and where.
privacyPage.rightsTitle: Your rights and your clients' rights
privacyPage.rightsBody: You can export or delete a client's data, or your whole account, from Settings. If a client asks you for their data, you can export it for them.
privacyPage.never1: We never use session content to train AI.
privacyPage.never2: We never sell or share data for advertising.
privacyPage.never3: We never put session content in logs, analytics or error reports.
privacyPage.never4: We never score risk, suggest diagnoses or advise you during a session.
privacyPage.status: Honest status: we're in a pilot. Before real client sessions are allowed, an independent Data Protection Impact Assessment will be completed.
privacyPage.contact: Questions about privacy? Write to us — a contact address will be published before launch.

dpa.title: Data Processing Agreement
dpa.draft: Draft — this summary will be replaced by a full agreement reviewed by legal counsel before real client data is allowed.
dpa.intro: When you use Psych Copilot for your practice, you are the data controller for your clients' information and we act as your data processor. In summary, we commit to:
dpa.p1: Process session data only on your instructions, to provide the service you use.
dpa.p2: Keep all session data in the European Union.
dpa.p3: Delete audio after transcription by default, and delete everything else when you ask or close your account.
dpa.p4: Never use session data to train AI models, and never sell or share it for advertising.
dpa.p5: Use only the sub-processors we list, and tell you before we add a new one.
dpa.p6: Protect data with encryption in transit and at rest, access controls and an audit log.
dpa.p7: Help you respond to your clients' data protection requests (access, correction, deletion).
dpa.p8: Tell you without undue delay if we become aware of a personal data breach.
